# Loading Libraries and Data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(sva)
library(reshape2)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(tibble)
library(survcomp)
data <- load("SKCM.rda")
clinical_followup <- read.csv("clinical_followup.csv")

# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis)

# Create proper survival object
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Calculate survival time in years
    survival_time = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", NA, days_to_death / 365),
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    
    # Convert age to years
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  
  # Handle missing values
  mutate(
    age_diagnosis = ifelse(is.na(age_diagnosis), median(age_diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE), age_diagnosis),
    ajcc_pathologic_stage = ifelse(is.na(ajcc_pathologic_stage), "Unknown", ajcc_pathologic_stage)
  )
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(patient_barcode = str_sub(rownames(clinical), 1, 12)) %>%
  mutate(full_barcode = rownames(clinical))

followup_latest <- clinical_followup %>%
  group_by(bcr_patient_barcode) %>%
  filter(!is.na(days_to_last_followup)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = days_to_last_followup, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(bcr_patient_barcode, days_to_last_followup)
clinical<- clinical %>%
  left_join(followup_latest, by = c("patient_barcode" = "bcr_patient_barcode"))
clinical <- clinical %>%
  column_to_rownames("full_barcode")
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    days_to_death = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", days_to_last_followup, days_to_death),
    survival_time = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", days_to_last_followup / 365, survival_time)
  )
clinical <- clinical%>%
  dplyr::select(-patient_barcode, -days_to_last_followup, -age_at_diagnosis, -vital_status)
clinical <- clinical %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time))
clinical <- clinical %>%
  filter(survival_time > 0)
fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")
log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)
```


```{r}
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 6) return(x[6]) else return(NA)
})
gene_var <- apply(log_expr, 1, var)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[gene_var > 0, ]
```

# Batch Correction

```{r message=FALSE}
# ComBat 
modcombat <- model.matrix(~1, data = data.frame(batch = batch))
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat = as.matrix(log_expr_filtered),
                      batch = batch,
                      mod = modcombat,
                      par.prior = TRUE,
                      prior.plots = FALSE)
```

# Cox Survival Model

## Feature Selection

```{r}
# Convert relevant character variables to factors
clinical$gender <- as.factor(clinical$gender)
clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage <- as.factor(clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage)
```

```{r}
gene_expr <- combat_expr

# Prepare the expression matrix and survival data
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(gene_expr))

# Subset both datasets to those common samples
X <- t(gene_expr[, common_samples])  

# Remove genes with near-zero variance 
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-5]

# Create the survival object
y <- Surv(clinical$survival_time, clinical$event)

# Fit LASSO Cox model using cross-validation to choose lambda
set.seed(123) 
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "cox", alpha = 1)

# Extract coefficients at the best lambda
lasso_coef <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
selected_genes <- rownames(lasso_coef)[as.vector(lasso_coef) != 0]

# Subset gene expression matrix by selected genes
selected_expr <- gene_expr[selected_genes, , drop = FALSE] 

# Transpose to get patients x genes 
selected_expr_t <- t(selected_expr)

# Ensure rownames match clinical data
common_patients <- intersect(rownames(clinical), rownames(selected_expr_t))

# Subset both datasets to the common patients
clinical_subset <- clinical[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]
expr_subset <- selected_expr_t[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]

# Combine into one data frame
cox_data <- cbind(clinical_subset, expr_subset)
cox_data <- cox_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-days_to_death)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Extract coefficients at lambda.min
coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")))
coef_df$feature <- rownames(coef_df)
colnames(coef_df)[1] <- "coefficient"

# Filter non-zero coefficients
nonzero_coef <- coef_df %>%
  filter(coefficient != 0)

# Filter gene features (Ensembl IDs)
nonzero_genes <- nonzero_coef %>%
  filter(str_detect(feature, "^ENSG"))

# Remove version suffix from Ensembl IDs
nonzero_genes <- nonzero_genes %>%
  mutate(feature = str_trim(feature)) %>%
  mutate(feature_clean = str_replace(feature, "\\..*$", ""))

# Connect to Ensembl database
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Extract unique cleaned Ensembl IDs
ensembl_ids_clean <- unique(nonzero_genes$feature_clean)

# Query biomaRt for gene symbols
gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = ensembl_ids_clean,
  mart = ensembl
) %>%
  rename(ensembl_id = ensembl_gene_id,
         gene_symbol = hgnc_symbol)

# Join gene symbols back to nonzero_genes by cleaned feature
if(nrow(gene_map) == 0){
  nonzero_genes$gene_symbol <- NA_character_
} else {
  nonzero_genes <- nonzero_genes %>%
    left_join(gene_map, by = c("feature_clean" = "ensembl_id"))
}

# Create plot label: use gene_symbol if available, else original feature (with version)
nonzero_genes <- nonzero_genes %>%
  mutate(plot_label = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol) | gene_symbol == "", feature, gene_symbol))

# Plot top genes by absolute coefficient
top_genes <- nonzero_genes %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(coefficient))) %>%
  head(20)  
ggplot(top_genes, aes(x = reorder(plot_label, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("green", "red"),
                    labels = c("Protective", "Risk"),
                    name = "Effect") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Genes by Importance",
       x = "Gene",
       y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()
```

This bar plot visualises the 20 most influential genes identified by the LASSO-regularized Cox proportional hazards model, based on their non-zero coefficients.

- Positive coefficients (top half of the plot) indicate genes whose higher expression is associated with increased hazard (worse prognosis).

- Negative coefficients (bottom half) indicate genes whose higher expression is associated with decreased hazard (better prognosis).

- The magnitude of each coefficient reflects how strongly the gene influences the risk score in the model.

# Fit Cox Model

```{r}
# Convert categorical variables to dummy variables
gender_dummies <- model.matrix(~ gender - 1, data = cox_data)
ajcc_stage_dummies <- model.matrix(~ ajcc_pathologic_stage - 1, data = cox_data)

# Combine the dummy variables with the numeric gene expression data
x <- cbind(cox_data[, -c(4, 5, 1, 2, 3)], gender_dummies, ajcc_stage_dummies)
x <- as.matrix(x)

# Ensure survival data is in the correct format
y <- Surv(cox_data$survival_time, cox_data$event)

# Fit the Cox model with the glmnet
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "cox")
lambda_min <- cv_fit$lambda.min
cox_summary <- summary(cv_fit)

# Get the linear predictors for each observation (risk scores)
risk_scores <- predict(cv_fit, s = lambda_min, newx = x, type = "link")

# Calculate concordance index
c_index <- concordance.index(x = risk_scores,
                             surv.time = cox_data$survival_time,
                             surv.event = cox_data$event,
                             method = "noether")
```

```{r}
# Extract non-zero coefficients at lambda.min
coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")))
coef_df$feature <- rownames(coef_df)
colnames(coef_df)[1] <- "coefficient"

# Filter non-zero coefficients
nonzero_coef <- coef_df %>%
  filter(coefficient != 0)

# Filter clinical features 
all_clinical <- nonzero_coef %>%
  filter(!str_detect(feature, "^ENSG"))
all_clinical <- all_clinical %>%
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    str_starts(feature, "ajcc_pathologic_stage") ~ str_remove(feature, "ajcc_pathologic_stage"),
    feature == "age_diagnosis" ~ "Age at Diagnosis",
    TRUE ~ feature 
  ),
  feature = str_trim(feature))

# Plot top clinical features
ggplot(all_clinical, aes(x = reorder(feature, coefficient), y = coefficient, fill = coefficient >= 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("green", "red"),
                  labels = c("Protective", "Risk"),
                  name = "Effect") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Clinical Feature Importance",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Coefficient") +
  theme_minimal()
```

This bar plot visualises the most influential clinical demographics identified by the LASSO-regularized Cox proportional hazards model, based on their coefficients.

- Positive coefficients (top half of the plot) indicate genes whose higher expression is associated with increased hazard (worse prognosis).

- Negative coefficients (bottom half) indicate genes whose higher expression is associated with decreased hazard (better prognosis).

- The magnitude of each coefficient reflects how strongly the gene influences the risk score in the model.

- Cofficients that are 0 indicate features that were not selected as important predictors by the model.

## Linear Risk Distribution

```{r}
# Convert risk scores to a numeric vector
risk_scores_vec <- as.vector(risk_scores)

# Add to your data frame
cox_data$linear_risk <- risk_scores_vec
```

```{r}
ggplot(cox_data, aes(x = linear_risk)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#ffbd59", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Risk Score Distribution",
       x = "Scaled Linear Risk",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Survival Fit

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(cox_data$survival_time, cox_data$event) ~ 1), 
           data = cox_data, 
           risk.table = TRUE,       
           pval = TRUE,             
           conf.int = TRUE,         
           xlab = "Survival Time",  
           ylab = "Survival Probability", 
           title = "Survival Curve for Cox Model")
```
## Metrics

| Concordance     |
|-----------------|
| `r round(c_index$c.index, 2)`| 
-------------------

- The Concordance value indicates a relatively strong agreement between the variables.

# Predicting a New Patient

```{r}
# Extract the exact features used in the model
model_features <- rownames(coef(cv_fit, s = lambda_min))

# Create a data frame with just one row and all features initialized to 0
new_patient <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = length(model_features)))
colnames(new_patient) <- model_features

# Fill in the specific values we have for the new patient
if("age_diagnosis" %in% colnames(new_patient)) {
  new_patient$age_diagnosis <- 48.1
}
if("gendermale" %in% colnames(new_patient)) {
  new_patient$gendermale <- 1
}
if("genderfemale" %in% colnames(new_patient)) {
  new_patient$genderfemale <- 0
}

for(col in colnames(new_patient)) {
  if(grepl("ajcc_pathologic_stage", col)) {
    new_patient[[col]] <- 0
  }
}
if("ajcc_pathologic_stageStage IIIC" %in% colnames(new_patient)) {
  new_patient$`ajcc_pathologic_stageStage IIIC` <- 1
}

# Gene expression values
gene_values <- list(
  "ENSG00000108700.5" = 3.12148346,
  "ENSG00000111206.13" = 4.109473,
  "ENSG00000137628.17" = 2.7165280,
  "ENSG00000140511.12" = 3.5243826,
  "ENSG00000140519.14" = 3.243052195,
  "ENSG00000162654.9" = 3.91157354,
  "ENSG00000164270.18" = -3.659215e-03,
  "ENSG00000174460.4" = 0.204181133,
  "ENSG00000175395.16" = 1.5412538,
  "ENSG00000182179.13" = 4.9035550,
  "ENSG00000182568.17" = 1.690075896,
  "ENSG00000183155.5" = 3.566287,
  "ENSG00000200737.1" = 0.339795190,
  "ENSG00000240793.1" = 1.096858718,
  "ENSG00000276116.2" = 0.139672264,
  "ENSG00000287114.1" = 0.0548535501
)

# Add gene expression values
for(gene in names(gene_values)) {
  if(gene %in% colnames(new_patient)) {
    new_patient[[gene]] <- gene_values[[gene]]
  }
}

# Convert to matrix and run prediction
new_patient_x <- as.matrix(new_patient)

# Make the prediction
lp_new <- predict(cv_fit, newx = new_patient_x, s = lambda_min, type = "link")

# Use the baseline survival curve
fit_km <- survfit(y ~ 1)  

# Calculate survival probability as baseline survival raised to exp(lp)
surv_probs <- fit_km$surv ^ exp(lp_new)

# Time in years
time_years <- fit_km$time

# Create a plot
plot(time_years, surv_probs, type = "l", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Time (Years)", ylab = "Survival Probability",
     main = "Predicted Survival for New Patient")
```

```{r}
new_risk_score <- predict(cv_fit, s = lambda_min, newx = new_patient_x, type = "link")
```

# Saving
```{r}
# Get baseline survival function for prediction
baseline_surv <- survfit(Surv(survival_time, event) ~ 1, data = cox_data)

# Save all the necessary objects for the Shiny app
save(
  cv_fit,          
  lambda_min,      
  selected_genes,  
  coef_df,         
  nonzero_coef,    
  c_index,         
  cox_data,        
  baseline_surv,   
  file = "cox_trials.RData"
)

# Save only the first two columns of log_expr
write.csv(as.data.frame(log_expr)[, 1:2], file = "sample_gene_data.csv")
```
